t: 在好望角，荷兰水手 Jan van Riebeeck 建立了一个补给营，最终成为开普敦。
te: At the Cape of Good Hope, Dutch sailor Jan van Riebeeck establishes a resupply camp that eventually becomes Cape Town.
dz: 在好望角，荷兰水手 Jan van Riebeeck 建立了一个补给营，最终成为开普敦。
de: At the Cape of Good Hope, Dutch sailor Jan van Riebeeck establishes a resupply camp that eventually becomes Cape Town.

t: 罗德岛废除了奴隶制,尽管法律没有得到严格执行.
te: Slavery in Rhode Island is abolished, although the law is not rigorously enforced.
dz: 罗德岛废除了奴隶制,尽管法律没有得到严格执行.
de: Slavery in Rhode Island is abolished, although the law is not rigorously enforced.

t: 塔洪库·艾哈迈德帕夏被任命为奥斯曼帝国的大维齐尔.
te: Tarhoncu Ahmed Pasha is appointed Grand Vizier of the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 塔洪库·艾哈迈德帕夏被任命为奥斯曼帝国的大维齐尔.
de: Tarhoncu Ahmed Pasha is appointed Grand Vizier of the Ottoman Empire.

t: 米歇尔·德·鲁伊特(英语:Michiel de Ruyter)和乔治·艾斯克(英语:Georg…
te: Inconclusive naval action between the fleets of Michiel de Ruyter and George Ayscue in the First Anglo-Dutch War.
dz: 普利茅斯战役:米歇尔·德·鲁伊特(英语:Michiel de Ruyter)和乔治·艾斯克(英语:George Ayscue)的分舰队在第一次盎格鲁-荷兰战争中的海军行动不尽如人意.

t: 大约 15,000 名汉族农民和民兵反抗荷兰对台湾的统治。
te: Around 15,000 Han farmers and militia rebel against Dutch rule on Taiwan.
dz: 大约 15,000 名汉族农民和民兵反抗荷兰对台湾的统治。

t: 在"敦煌之战"中战败,使英格兰联邦改革了自己的海军.
te: Defeat at the Battle of Dungeness causes the Commonwealth of England to reform its navy.
dz: 在"敦煌之战"中战败,使英格兰联邦改革了自己的海军.
